description: Nucleoid mixes explicit and direct conditional alternatives without indented header colons
code:
def route(state, urgent):
    if state == "blocked"
        return "hold"
    else if urgent
        return "fast"
    elif state == "ready"
        return "send"
    else:
        return "wait"
state = "ready"
urgent = false
lane = route(state, urgent)
assert(lane, "send")
urgent = true
assert(lane, "fast")
state = "blocked"
assert(lane, "hold")
urgent = false
state = "queued"
assert(lane, "wait")
lane

description: Nucleoid keeps colon-free conditional class suites reactive independently per instance
code:
class Parcel
first = Parcel()
first.state = "queued"
second = Parcel()
second.state = "ready"
if $Parcel.state == "blocked"
    $Parcel.lane = "hold"
else $Parcel.state == "ready"
    $Parcel.lane = "send"
elif:
    $Parcel.lane = "wait"
$Parcel.label = $Parcel.lane + "!"
assert(first.lane, "wait")
assert(second.label, "send!")
first.state = "blocked"
assert(first.label, "hold!")
assert(second.lane, "send")
second.state = "queued"
assert(first.lane, "hold")
assert(second.label, "wait!")
second.label

description: Nucleoid preserves frozen classifier definitions and live inputs with colon-free conditional suites
code:
def classify(state):
    if state == "ready"
        return "send"
    else:
        return "wait"
state = "ready"
frozen = classify.value
live = classify(state)
usingFrozen = frozen(state)
snapshot = usingFrozen.value
assert(live, "send")
assert(usingFrozen, "send")
def classify(state):
    if state == "ready"
        return "go"
    else:
        return "queue"
assert(live, "go")
assert(usingFrozen, "send")
state = "queued"
assert(live, "queue")
assert(usingFrozen, "wait")
assert(snapshot, "send")
live

description: Nucleoid rolls back failed reactive alternatives while preserving colon-free suite behavior
code:
source = "ready"
def route(status):
    if status == "ready"
        return "send"
    else status == "hold"
        return "wait"
    else:
        return "skip"
live = route(source)
assert(live, "send")
try:
    source = "hold"
    def route(status):
        if status == "ready"
            return "send"
        elif status == "hold"
            throw "blocked"
        else:
            return "skip"
catch error:
    assert(error, "blocked")
assert(source, "ready")
assert(live, "send")
source = "hold"
assert(live, "wait")
source = "unknown"
assert(live, "skip")
live
